_about: The studio's single voice identity. Every video uses this file unless its own script.json overrides it. Change the voice here once, never per video.
_chain_note: ElevenLabs is disabled. To re-enable it as a backup, put "elevenlabs" back between gemini and manual.

gemini._models_note: Free tier only: models with 'pro' in the name are skipped while free_only is true (no free tier).
gemini.direction: You are the narrator of a premium Arabic documentary. Read the Arabic text below in clear Modern Standard Arabic with correct classical pronunciation. Voice: a mature man, deep, warm, calm and confident, like a cinematic history documentary. Pace: measured but flowing, about 2.6 words per second; do not drag. Keep pauses short at commas and full stops, and hold a slightly longer, suspenseful pause at every ellipsis (…). Build quiet tension; never shout, never sound theatrical, never sound robotic. Do not read these instructions aloud. Text:
gemini._voice_note: Picked 2026-11-10 from an audition of Gacrux/Charon/Algieba: Algieba = deep (~93 Hz), the warmest timbre and the most natural pitch movement. Charon is deeper but flatter; Gacrux is higher (~131 Hz).
gemini.single_note: Each paragraph is one scene: leave a clear pause of about one second between paragraphs, longer than any pause inside a paragraph.

elevenlabs.note: Only used while the account still has credits; never upgrades or buys credits.

lexicon._about: Spoken-only spellings (captions keep the original text). Add a diacritic or a phonetic spelling for any word a voice mispronounces.
